query: how do I keep inventory accurate while staying ready for the health inspection?
final_answer:
## ANSWER

Maintain inventory accuracy and inspection readiness by integrating automated tracking with compliant documentation. Use ingredient-level inventory with barcode scanners to capture lot numbers, receipt dates, and quantities in real-time. Configure expiration date alerts to proactively prevent expired-product violations. Conduct weekly physical counts using inventory scanners to verify system accuracy. Maintain digital record-keeping that generates inspection-ready reports on demand. Organize food storage with clear labeling and FIFO rotation. Set inventory alert systems to trigger documentation updates when discrepancies arise. This unified approach satisfies health department inspection requirements for record-keeping and traceability while keeping your inventory system continuously accurate and defensible.
